name: Devorce
overview: Scripture addresses divorce with solemn seriousness, emphasizing God's disapproval of the practice except in cases of marital unfaithfulness. Deuteronomy 24:1 outlines the process of issuing a certificate of divorce when a man finds 'uncleanness' in his wife, while Malachi 2:16 clearly states that the Lord hates divorce because it covers violence with one's garment. Jesus reinforces this teaching in Matthew 19:9 and Mark 10:12 by declaring that divorcing a spouse, except for fornication, and remarrying constitutes adultery. These passages collectively reveal that marriage is intended to be a lifelong covenant, and divorce is permitted only under limited, serious circumstances.
